column1: # mkexpect.py --reasons for piglit's gpu profile on our driver: REGEX<tab>why, first match wins

column2: interpolation through gl_ClipVertex: user clip planes not implemented (M6); the flat ones need flat shading too
gl_FragDepth isn't written yet: the compiler leaves it for a depthf whose form isn't traced, so the triangle's depth is used (st draws and copies depth pixels with gl_FragDepth too)
varyings: more components than ten sets of four hold (varying-packing: sgx_pack_varyings can't place them); texrect-many not diagnosed
the window's buffers on the surfaceless platform: these read, draw or blit the front buffer or the window's depth/stencil, which a surfaceless context doesn't have (piglit aborts or reads nothing)
no context of the kind the test asks for (waffle_context_create fails)

depth textures: no sampler format for a depth format (sgx_tex_format has the five 8-bit T1 codes), so a GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT texture crashes; the T1 codes need a DDK capture (probe depth16/depth32/d24s8)
depth and stencil read back, copied, drawn or blitted, and depth written by the shader: no depth/stencil buffer is loaded or stored yet (no ZLS), so they live only within one render
flat shading: the rasterizer's flatshade and flat varyings are ignored, the hardware's shade-mode state is not known yet (needs a GLES1 DDK glShadeModel capture)
two-sided stencil: the back-face stencil state, not diagnosed
user clip planes: not implemented (M6)
polygon modes and edge flags: not implemented (M6); points and lines culled as triangles
line stipple: not implemented
logic ops: not implemented
fog: fixed-function and ARB-program fog colours wrong, not diagnosed
cube maps: NPOT ones of 16 texels or more, or mipmapped, aren't drawn (a stopgap: no layout is known for NPOT faces and they locked the 3D, PIGLIT.md), POT faces fail the probes, not diagnosed
3D textures: not implemented (GL_MAX_3D_TEXTURE_SIZE reads back as INT_MIN)
wrap modes and border colour: GL_CLAMP and CLAMP_TO_BORDER are drawn as CLAMP_TO_EDGE (no border colour); texwrap also fails NEAREST/REPEAT on GL_RGBA8, not diagnosed
texture formats: only five sampler formats (RGBA8, 565, A8, L8, LA88), so other sized and compressed formats fall back or are refused
mipmaps: LOD clamps, base level and LOD bias aren't programmed (M6), generated mipmaps of non-RGBA8 formats
rectangle and 1D textures: wrong texels, not diagnosed
derivatives: dFdx/dFdy/fwidth compile (fdsx/fdsy) but give wrong values, not diagnosed
points: fixed-function point sprites (coordinate replacement) not implemented (M6), large and zero-size points, not diagnosed
varyings and attributes: gl_TexCoord arrays, packed and indexed varyings, attribute locations, not diagnosed
min/max with a NaN operand: wrong result, not diagnosed
uniform limits: arrays larger than the 120-vec4 vertex limit (ARB vp params 1021 > 119; GLSL arrays not found after linking)
occlusion queries: GetObjivAval_multi2 (several queries in flight) fails, not diagnosed
ARB and ATI fragment programs: wrong colours, not diagnosed
pixel paths: glDrawPixels, glBitmap, raster position, PBO and sub-image uploads and copies give wrong pixels, not diagnosed
texture coordinate generation: wrong, not diagnosed
texture units and samplers: another unit's texture or sampler is read (red where green is expected), not diagnosed
gl_FragCoord in an FBO: wrong values, not diagnosed
shader tests that crash (SIGSEGV, nothing printed), not diagnosed
abort with nothing printed (as the surfaceless window-buffer tests do), not diagnosed
triangle rasterization: edge pixels differ from piglit's reference rasterizer, not diagnosed
blend factors: wrong blended colours, not diagnosed
vertex colour clamping: wrong colours, not diagnosed
FBO completeness: renderbuffers of different sizes aren't reported incomplete
a 2048x2048 render target draws wrong, not diagnosed
materials in display lists: wrong lighting, not diagnosed
a linked program with no shaders draws black, not diagnosed
GLSL programs drawing wrong colours, not diagnosed
API checks that fail (client memory bounds; an Intel query), not diagnosed
slow: over the 60 s timeout
